tiebreakers.description: Still tied: the player who went later in turn order wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro (running-track + end bonuses). Base-game scoring: points during play already sit on the VP track; final scoring adds unsold goods (1 each), Silverlings (1 each), every 2 workers (1), and VP-bearing yellow tiles. Unplaced six-sided tiles in storage score nothing. Tiebreak: fewest empty estate spaces, then later in turn order. Special Edition rulebook could not be fetched; categories follow the original alea/Ravensburger rulebook (same game). Special Edition components/extra modules and solo target not modelled; verify against the Special Edition rulebook.
